# 🧠 dsh-plugin-clm (Context Language Models for DeepSeek Harness)

> **Active editable context window mirrored to disk for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).**
> Inspired by Meta
CLM (*Context Language Models*) & `pi-clm`.
## Overview
**`dsh-plugin-clm`** transforms the conventional monolithic, append-only context window of DeepSeek
Harness into an **active, disk-mirrored, and editable context document** (`.dsh/clm/LIVE_CONTEXT.md`
rness into an **active, disk-mirrored, and editable context document** (`.dsh/clm/LIVE_CONTEXT.md`).
In standard LLM conversational loops, the chat history grows indefinitely, accumulating bloated tool
dumps, stale search outputs, and abandoned debugging attempts. This consumes thousands of tokens an
d degrades model reasoning over long conversations.
With CLM active, the agent and user can actively **prune, compress, and curate** the live conversati
onal state on disk before each generation step.
## ✨ Key Features
- 🔄 **Real-Time Context Synchronization**: Mirrors the ongoing session context into a structured Mar

kdown document (`.dsh/clm/LIVE_CONTEXT.md`).
- ✂️ **Active Context Pruning**: Enables the model to c

ompress extensive terminal dumps and tool results into concise summary notes.
- 🎛️ **Native UI Contr
ol**: Seamlessly integrated `[ 🧠 CLM ON 🟢 / CLM OFF ⚪ ]` toggle button in the chat input bar, operat

ing cleanly in the background.
- 🛡️ **Token Overflow Guard**: Automatically enforces context budgets

(`budgetTokens: 64000`, `reserveTokens: 4096`) to prevent sudden context overruns.
- ⚡ **Per-Sessio
n State Persistence**: Remembers enabled/disabled state across app reloads and per conversation.

## 🛠️ Slash Commands
| Command | Description |

| `/clm on` | Enables active editable context mirroring for the current session |
| `/clm off` | Dis

ables CLM mode and falls back to standard append-only context |
| `/clm status` | Displays estimated

context tokens, revisions, and mirror file path |
| `/clm reset` | Clears and regenerates a clean m
irror state for the session |
